title: Model Y E36: The Octovalve Episode
summary: Munro Live's Model Y episode 36 has Sandy Munro walk through the disassembled Tesla Octovalve and heat pump system. He explains how the components are made and what each one does.
why: HN cites it as a deeper look at Tesla's integrated thermal management system, from a commentator respected for auto industry knowledge.

quote.text: Sandy generally has great commentary on the auto industry.
